_info: ORBITA chat session logs — written by the Vite dev server when running locally (pnpm dev).

_format.sessionId: unique ID per browser tab — resets on every page refresh
_format.startedAt: ISO timestamp when the chat was first opened
_format.questionCount: how many questions the visitor asked

_note: Production visitors (GitHub Pages) cannot write here — sessions exist only in their browser tab. Run locally with pnpm dev to capture live sessions.
